attack_techniques: Archive Collected Data: Archive via Utility (T1560.001)
attackers_goals: Stage data on an endpoint in the organization.
description: An archive file was created by a user who doesn't usually create such files. This might indicate an attempt to stage data before exfiltration.
investigative_actions: Check for any other suspicious activity related to the host and the user involved in the alert.
